arm_a.answer: Changing AppContext.push (the current RequestContext alias) to async would immediately affect Flask.wsgi_app, because it calls ctx.push() synchronously before full_dispatch_request. It would also affect all context-manager entry points such as AppContext.__enter__ and any testing helpers that rely on `with ctx:` or `app.test_request_context(...)`, including FlaskClient.session_transaction in testing.py. Inside push, Flask currently opens the session through app.session_interface.open_session and then runs match_request, so session availability and routing would no longer be ready synchronously unless those callers were also made async-aware.
